entries.07d71ae9664da155: A segment that provides communications services and communications technology, operates electricity supply services, and makes investments related to the mobile segment.
entries.0ddcfcbbe3ede921: This segment operates various EC sites including the internet shopping mall "Rakuten Ichiba", online cash-back sites, travel reservation sites, portal sites and digital content sites, provides messaging services, sells advertising on these sites, and operates professional sports. "Rakuten Ichiba" is not a store where Rakuten Group, Inc. itself buys and sells products; it is a business that operates a marketplace where tenant stores sell products, and provides AI-based tools to support tenant stores and more. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,369,697 million, the largest among the 3 reportable segments.
entries.1697c67fff7a3edf: Payment business operated by Rakuten Payment, Inc.
entries.1a1e3f1849b5ec4a: Sales of Open RAN-based communications infrastructure platforms and related services
entries.1ba16b0133f1a5a2: A segment providing credit card-related services, internet banking and securities services, intermediation of crypto-assets (virtual currencies), life insurance services, non-life insurance services, and payment services.
entries.227ca7d8475e649f: A company engaged in "Rakuten Ichiba," a shopping mall where participating stores sell products, as well as financial services such as cards, banking and securities, and a mobile communications network.
entries.444280ce05a25fa2: Operation of professional sports. In November 2004, the entry of "Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles" as a new member was approved by the Japan Professional Baseball Organization (now the Japan Professional Baseball Organization, a general incorporated association), and in November 2013 it won its first Japan Series title.
entries.4704aa6a74e4ba2e: Internet banking services provided by Rakuten Bank, Ltd.
entries.4c0b9846e53a3803: Online securities trading services provided by Rakuten Securities, Inc. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, fee and interest income grew as the customer base continued to expand and revenue sources diversified. Revenue from external customers for “Rakuten Securities” was ¥154,178 million. In October 2022, Rakuten Securities Holdings, Inc. and Mizuho Securities Co., Ltd. entered into a capital and business alliance.
entries.5cfbee713c2b0e22: A segment that provides communications services and communications technology, operates electricity supply services, and makes investments related to the mobile segment. Rakuten Mobile, Inc. operates its own mobile communications network, and in December 2025 total contracted lines (combining MNO, MVNE and MVNO lines, including the BCP plan for corporate customers) exceeded 10 million lines. Revenue for the segment in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥482,838 million, the smallest of the 3 segments, and the segment loss was ¥161,841 million. The company explains that it achieved EBITDA profitability in its mobile business in the same fiscal year.
entries.5f4746c9b0da67d6: The life insurance business of Rakuten Life Insurance Co., Ltd. and the non-life insurance business of Rakuten General Insurance Co., Ltd.
entries.773d5b81516286e8: Issuance of the "Rakuten Card" credit card and related services
entries.7c40a8b8031d2e8d: These are domestic EC and reservation services centered on "Rakuten Ichiba" and "Rakuten Travel". In the fiscal year ended December 2025, it focused on acquiring new customers and nurturing loyal users, promoting cross-use mainly among mobile users, and developing AI Concierge, an agent-type AI tool, and the gross merchandise sales and revenue of "Rakuten Ichiba" grew. "Rakuten Travel" saw its transaction volume expand on inbound demand from the increase in foreign tourists visiting Japan. Revenue from external customers for "Rakuten Ichiba" and "Rakuten Travel" combined was ¥556,790 million.
entries.84013aa8fd7b8419: A business in which Rakuten Card Co., Ltd. issues the “Rakuten Card” and provides related services. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, fee income increased as membership and shopping transaction volume expanded, and each fee income item grew as revolving balances and card cash loan balances continued to expand. Revenue from external customers for the “Rakuten Card” was ¥237,197 million. In November 2024, Rakuten Card Co., Ltd. and Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. entered into a capital and business alliance.
entries.892ceb702361bf14: A business in which Rakuten Card Co., Ltd. issues the “Rakuten Card” and provides related services.
entries.970e3d19c67b6f18: A division operating internet services overseas.
entries.9ec4f35c96ad4678: A division operating internet services overseas. Rakuten Kobo Inc. saw revenue expand from color-capable devices launched in 2024 and from content sales, while Viber Media S.a.r.l. operating the messaging service "Rakuten Viber" saw increases in communication and advertising revenue. In North America, the online cashback service is run by Ebates Inc.
entries.b0af30cfde9a98df: These are the mobile communication service operated by Rakuten Mobile, Inc., the optical broadband line service "Rakuten Hikari", and the electricity supply service "Rakuten Denki". In the fiscal year ended December 2025, it worked on improving communication quality and raising awareness of it, offering the new pack "Rakuten Strongest U-NEXT", marketing that uses services of the Rakuten ecosystem such as "Rakuten Ichiba" and "Rakuten Card", and acquiring subscribers for corporate plans. In October 2023, its specified base station opening plan (allocation of the "platinum band" 700MHz band) was certified.
entries.b78345225fd25d0a: The life insurance business of Rakuten Life Insurance Co., Ltd. and the non-life insurance business of Rakuten General Insurance Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, insurance premium income grew as sales channels suited to each product’s characteristics were used.
entries.b7e0797f56c3549e: Online securities trading services provided by Rakuten Securities, Inc.
entries.cb6cb35ce1fa18cf: Books and other products sales site "Rakuten Books"
entries.cc159da1819a143b: Internet banking services provided by Rakuten Bank, Ltd. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, investment assets grew with the expansion of the customer base, and investment yields improved as the Bank of Japan raised its policy interest rate, causing investment income to grow significantly. Revenue from external customers for “Rakuten Bank” was ¥158,360 million. Rakuten Bank, Ltd. listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in April 2023.

entries.ea22c0801f26c710: Payment business operated by Rakuten Payment, Inc. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, transaction volume increased as the number of “Rakuten Pay” users grew.

Rakuten Symphony Singapore Pte. Ltd. and others are responsible for it. The mobile segment is the only segment with made-to-order production; in the fiscal year ended December 2025, orders received were ¥34,487 million and order backlog was ¥42,980 million.
entries.f3a02f7dc9a9aa51: Mobile messaging and VoIP service "Rakuten Viber"
entries.f49577c564e1a294: The mobile communications service operated by Rakuten Mobile, Inc., the optical broadband line service "Rakuten Hikari," and the electricity supply service "Rakuten Denki."
entries.f8b1fd1c0c6f0042: A segment providing credit card-related services, internet banking and securities services, intermediation of crypto-assets (virtual currencies), life insurance services, non-life insurance services, and payment services. The service entities are Rakuten Card Co., Ltd., Rakuten Bank, Ltd., Rakuten Securities, Inc., Rakuten Payment, Inc., Rakuten Insurance, Inc., Rakuten Life Insurance Co., Ltd., and Rakuten International Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. in Taiwan. Revenue consists not of sales of products but of card fee income, bank income from fund management and interest, securities fee and interest income, insurance premium income, and payment fee income. Revenue for the segment in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥975,931 million, and segment profit was ¥199,922 million, the largest profit among the three segments.
